newsitem.title: QATAR: Israel's Weizman sends get-well cable to Qatar Emir.
newsitem.headline: Israel's Weizman sends get-well cable to Qatar Emir.

text.p: Israeli President Ezer Weizman has sent a cable congratulating Qatar's Emir Sheikh Hamad bin Khalifa al-Thani on a successful kidney transplant, the official Qatar News Agency said on Sunday.
It said Weizman wished Sheikh Hamad a speedy recovery from last Tuesday's surgery in the United States, where he is said to be recuperating well.
Sheikh Hamad, 47, toppled his father Sheikh Khalifa in a bloodless palace coup in June 1995. He has a reputation as a maverick among Gulf Arab leaders for openness towards Iran, Iraq and Israel.

Qatar and Oman are the only members of the six-state Gulf Cooperation Council -- which also includes Saudi Arabia, Kuwait, Bahrain and the United Arab Emirates -- to have set up trade relations with Israel. They stopped short of establishing diplomatic ties with the Jewish state.
Qatar is preparing to host a controversial Middle East and North Africa economic summit in November which Israel is expected to attend.

Many Arab countries including Saudi Arabia, the United Arab Emirates, Syria and Lebanon have expressed opposition to holding the meeting with Israel under the current circumstances in the Middle East.
